technical.summary: DLTR shows strong structural bullish alignment but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9: 82.79, Stoch: 88.46) with stalling momentum and no fresh crossover signals create high pullback risk; entry quality compromised by exhaustion despite positive technicals.

fundamental.summary: DLTR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 78 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite congressional insider selling by senior Republican; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (348.8), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and imminent CPI event in 2 days create hostile trading environment despite low near-term earnings risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme overbought RSI (82.79) and contrarian fear-zone sentiment create classic reversal setup with price structurally above major moving averages and support at 157.86 providing defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum is stalling (RSI rising false, no crossover signals), macro environment is hostile (VIX crisis, CPI event in 2 days, recession yield curve), earnings risk is high within 78 days, and congressional insiders are selling—entry quality is weak despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 82.79, Stoch 88.46) with stalling momentum create textbook exhaustion setup; contrarian fear-zone sentiment offers theoretical reversal opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Hostile macro environment (VIX crisis, CPI event in 2 days, recession yield curve) combined with high earnings risk (78 days) and congressional insider selling creates compounding downside catalysts that outweigh technical overbought setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness despite technical strength
